name: Sasaragawa Mayuka
source:
She has been living in the house since before Hazuki, and is difficult to look after. She works at night and sleeps most of the time during the day, but she gets along well with Hazuki and Anju, acting as their big sister. She likes Akira as soon as she meets him, and sometimes pesters him because he is a boy of her age.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1138957]Getchu[/url]]
